craft_notes: Sthāyin: license-joy (fit to teach). Sanskrit first: qualification + standing + fitness → L4 sets qualification line 1, license line 2. Rows: row 6 (teaching-voice kept — the license IS the verse). Rupture: colon after aware — qualified, licensed. Close: end-weight on rightness. Minimal pass: colon for L3 comma. Read aloud: word, taste, fit. Rejected: 'experience' — killed at L0 (taste kept); 'disciples' for śiṣya — kept? L4 'pupils' — pupils plain, disciples churchy.

lines: His method word and taste, unbroken self-aware:
his teaching stands fit: pupils wakened right.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vāganubhavasadyuktir yasyāsti nirantaraṃ svasaṃvittau / tasyopadeśakaraṇaṃ yuktaṃ śiṣyeṣu bodhanaṃ samyak

reads_against.argmap: Word-and-taste his true method, unbroken in awareness — he is fit to awaken pupils rightly.
c1_essence: Word-and-taste his method: fit to awaken pupils.
